title: docs(skills): a generated platform catalog, and objectstack-project asks "does the platform ship it?"
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg646vnpLvaexGfHCmasWBga)_

Fixes #35345

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：写元数据应用的人在加对象、字段或流程之前，技能先让他翻一份自动生成的平台能力目录：平台已经带的（用户、附件、评论、审计、通知、邮件、汇率、导入、审批、共享、队列、Webhook、设置）直接用；平台没有而别的应用也会要的，先给平台立卡、应用里自建并打标记。平台本身的运行行为不变。
- 为什么做：跨套件主数据那项决定要求"先查平台有没有"成为建应用的固定一步；没有这份目录，各应用会各自重建平台已有的对象，升级时成双份。
- 出错会怎样：只涉及技能文本与一份生成的参考页；目录若与平台源码不一致，生成门禁会红而不会发出错版本；撤回本次合并即可，无数据影响。
- 要你做什么：无，席位复核后落地（一个技能文件的字数上限按卡上的裁决记录抬了一行，正文有算账）。

## 席位核对

### What changes

**1. The platform catalog, generated.** `skills/objectstack-project/references/platform-catalog.md` is emitted by the existing `packages/spec/scripts/build-skill-references.ts` (the `check:skill-refs` generator), so the same `--check` leg verifies it and the generated manifest proves its ownership. The hand lists live in a new `packages/spec/scripts/lib/platform-catalog.ts` — outside `packages/spec/src/**`, nothing exported from the package:

- `APP_FACING_OBJECT_GROUPS` — 30 objects in six groups (people and organizations; files, comments and history; notifications and mail; money, imports and approvals; sharing, ownership and routing; integration and settings). Each row: the object, what the app would otherwise build, how the app reaches it. The **name** column is not typed into the page: every row must be a member of `PLATFORM_PROVIDED_OBJECT_NAMES` and the "Mounted by" column is derived from `PLATFORM_OBJECTS_BY_PACKAGE` (`packages/spec/src/system/constants/platform-object-names.ts:37`, `:193`).
- `VALUE_DOMAIN_ROWS` — a `Record<ValueDomain, …>`, so a member added to `ValueDomainSchema` (`packages/spec/src/shared/value-domain.zod.ts:96-100`) is a type error until the catalog names it; the field names come from `VALUE_DOMAIN_FIELD_NAMES` (`:114-118`, whose jsdoc already says this catalog reads it). The section's paragraph states what `main` does: the write refuses a non-member; forms pick the currency code from ISO 4217 (`ui/packages/fields/src/widgets/TextField.tsx`, the `iso_4217_currency` swap only); a time zone or a country is a plain text input, and no list or filter reads the domain; a text field named like one without the domain is an `os lint` warning (`field/missing-value-domain`).
- `CAPABILITY_ROWS` — one line per token of `PLATFORM_CAPABILITY_TOKENS` (`packages/spec/src/kernel/platform-capabilities.ts`), with the mounting package from `PLATFORM_CAPABILITY_PROVIDERS` and the always-on set from `PLATFORM_ALWAYS_ON_CAPABILITIES`.
- `NOT_PLATFORM_ROWS` — party master data (customers, suppliers, contacts) and item master data (materials, products, plants): one app owns each, another matches by the ruled keys (country plus credit code or registration number; material number and plant code), no platform object — ruling A on #35328.
- `PLANNED_ROWS` — two rows, each **not available**: units → ADR-0158 (contract accepted, nothing shipped); working calendars → #35340 (carded, contract in design). The section's paragraph says an interim unit field stores the contract's UN/ECE Rec 20 codes (`H87`, `KGM`) as option values with the business's spellings as labels, which is what eval 22 asserts. `catalogProblems()` refuses a Planned row whose state reads as usable, a relative link or a bare `#NNNNN`, and more than four rows (ADR-0049: a planned row never reads as shipped).

`catalogProblems()` runs before `renderPlatformCatalog()`; a problem makes `check:skill-refs` fail with "hand-written rows disagree with packages/spec/src" instead of emitting a page. Every hand-written paragraph is in the exported `PROSE` constant and every hand-written string is summed by `handWrittenBytes()` (see the pin test): the page is generator-owned for the ratchet, but its prose has an author who pays.

**2. The pin test** `packages/spec/scripts/platform-catalog.test.ts` (53 cases with the sibling guards file): the live catalog has no problem; every object row is registered, unique, both columns filled; the subset leaves out the kernel-only objects (`sys_jwks` and friends); capability keys equal the token set, value-domain keys equal `ValueDomainSchema.options`; a fabricated catalog passes, and one with `sys_fictional`, a duplicate, an empty cell, a stranger token, a missing domain, a usable-sounding Planned row, a bare id, a relative link or five Planned rows is refused — each named; the generator source imports the lib, guards before rendering, and manages only the catalog path; and a **pricing leg** holds the hand-written text under a shrink-only ceiling in the ratchet's own measure, `ceil(utf8 bytes / 4)`: 6331 bytes → 1583 tokens on the first round, 6321 bytes → 1581 after the second (the Planned paragraph's unit-code clause, paid by four cuts in `PROSE`; the pin lowered to the measurement), raised only by the ratchet header's path (cut first, then the measured remainder under the standing ruling), with the derived names, packages, editions and boot flags left out so a token the spec adds costs one description line.

**3. Gate edits (read these as gate edits — the claim amendment 7012111198 widened the file surface for exactly them):**

- `scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs` — ONE line: the `spec-skill-refs` row's `candidate` regexp is now `/^skills\/[^/]+\/references\/(?:_index|platform-catalog)\.md$/`. The regexp is the narrowing gate; the manifest still proves each file is generator-owned, so a hand edit to the catalog stays governed. No other row or rule touched.
- `scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` — the self-test's pinned excluded-path list names `skills/objectstack-project/references/platform-catalog.md` (without it the ratchet prices a generated file as hand-authored and every regeneration turns it red); and the `skills/objectstack-project/SKILL.md` ceiling row is raised `2901 → 2990`, with the raise's authority (the standing path, ruling record 6513306068, alone) and arithmetic in the row's comment (see Verification › skills readings); the `skills/objectstack-data/rules/field-types.md` row is lowered `3553 → 3541` to its measurement.
- `scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs --self-test` — two cases in the `#11705` battery (floor 23 → 25): the catalog path routes to the `spec-skill-refs` row while four near-miss spellings (another folder, `.mdx`, `-catalogue`, `.md.bak`) stay governed; and the catalog's prose source location is pinned — the generator's import resolves to a module under the row's `trustedGeneratorPrefixes` that exports `PROSE`.

**4. `skills/objectstack-project/SKILL.md`.** §0 is now "Three questions before any work": the third asks "Does the platform ship it?" — read the catalog, use what it lists; absent, and a second app would copy it, file a platform card at `objectstack-ai/objectstack` and build the app's own meanwhile, marked `// PLATFORM-CANDIDATE: <link>`; textually apart from §3 ("a defect is never worked around; a missing capability may be built and marked"). §5 step 4 sweeps the `PLATFORM-CANDIDATE` markers beside the `PLATFORM-GAP` tests. Question 3 (`:46-51`) follows the "Default to own use" paragraph that belongs to question 2 (`:42-44`), so the two questions read apart; the MCP-only sentence (`:53`, "only §0 and §3 apply") covers the new question through §0. Paid for by two same-file cuts: the "read it from there afterwards" clause in question 2 and the "Inject the defect and run the command" aside in §2 (its instruction survives in the §2 retire paragraph, `:134-137`).

**5. `skills/objectstack-data/rules/field-types.md`.** The currency paragraph (`:170-172`) gains one sentence, in its current wording: "Likewise `'iana_time_zone'` (`Asia/Shanghai`) and `'iso_3166_alpha2'` (`CN`) on a `text` field: the write refuses a non-member, so never a free-text or picklist copy." The `// per record:` literal stays (`:160-161`): it is the one place the data skill shows `homeAmount` nested inside `currencyConfig`, and eval 24 expects that shape. Paid for in the same file by four restatement cuts — the `localization.currency` sentence (said by the roll-up paragraph's "metadata never names the home currency"), the `password` row's "never hashed" aside (said by "PLAINTEXT at rest"), the autonumber "(it grows, never wraps)" aside (said by "a MINIMUM, not a cap") and its `CASE-{0000}` example (in the table above it), and "for every one" after `--all-organizations` — and the row is lowered to the measurement, 3553 → 3541, to bank the headroom (shrink-only).

**6. Evals.** `skills/objectstack-project/evals/project-process.json` 7–9 (an attachments table → `sys_attachment` + `files: true`; a business-hours calendar → a platform card + `PLATFORM-CANDIDATE`, not "Blocked by"; an audit table → `sys_audit_log` / `sys_activity`). `skills/objectstack-data/evals/objects-fields-relationships.json` 22–24 (a free-text unit → a `select` whose option values are the contract's UN/ECE Rec 20 codes in exact uppercase, `H87` for a piece, `KGM`, `XBX`, with the business's spellings as labels, so the platform unit table later adds validation and leaves stored values unchanged — ADR-0158 U1/U2 — plus `PLATFORM-CANDIDATE`; country and time zone → the two value domains, a plain text input for both, no picklist, no regex; an exchange-rate table → `sys_exchange_rate` + `homeAmount`).

**7. Changeset** `.changeset/35345-skills-platform-catalog.md`, `@objectstack/skills: patch`, the two declaration lines copied in. No `@objectstack/spec` changeset: `packages/spec`'s `files[]` does not ship `scripts/`, and nothing under `src/` moved.

**Not in this PR (ruled out of scope):** a value-domain lint, a shadow-object lint, `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/**`. Sibling #35442 (`packages/mcp/**`) is file-disjoint; overlap-check at `origin/main` clean, 0 PR heads.

### Per-row reach readings (every catalog row says how the app reaches the object; these are the sources)

<details><summary>Object rows: what each `sys-*.object.ts` exposes</summary>

`enable.apiEnabled` defaults to true; `apiMethods` undefined = all six primitives, `['get','list']` = read-only over REST.

- People and organizations — `sys_user` `apiMethods: ['get','list','update','bulk']` + `aiReadable` (`plugin-security/src/objects/sys-user.object.ts:1661-1689`); `sys_organization` `['get','list','update']` (`sys-organization.object.ts:560-583`); `sys_business_unit` default-open (`:297-304`; apps seed it, `stack.zod.ts:2886`); `sys_team` `['get','list']` (`:243-255`; approvers `'team'`, `approval.zod.ts:35`); `sys_user_position` full CRUD (`:223-229`; positions distribute permission sets, ADR-0090).
- Files, comments and history — `sys_file` / `sys_attachment` `apiEnabled: true` (`sys-attachment.object.ts:141-144`), uploads through `/api/v1/storage/upload/...`, the `enable.files` switch (`object.zod.ts:392`); `sys_comment` (`:319-322`) with `enable.feeds` (`object.zod.ts:401`); `sys_activity` `['get','list']` (`:431-435`) with `enable.activities`; `sys_audit_log` `['get','list']` (`:690-694`; the `audit` capability token is opt-in); `sys_recycle_bin` `apiEnabled: false` (`:119-123`) — reached only through `POST /api/v1/data/:object/recycle-bin/:entryId/restore` (`rest/recycle-bin-routes.test.ts:78`), which is what the row says.
- Notifications and mail — `sys_notification` `['get','list']` (`:271-274`); `sys_inbox_message` (`:162`); `sys_email` (`:288-291`); `sys_mailbox` and `sys_mail_message` are `managedBy: 'engine-owned'` (`packages/services/service-mailbox/src/objects/sys-mailbox.object.ts:33`, `sys-mail-message.object.ts:36`), served through get and list only, the mailbox to `manage_mailboxes` holders; `requires: ['mailbox']` mounts the objects and the ingest seam and syncs no mailbox — rows exist only where the host composes `MailboxServicePlugin({ imap })` with an account source (`packages/services/service-mailbox/README.md:5`, `:11-12`, `:30`); no Setup entry names the mailbox; `mailAssociation` field type (`field.zod.ts:2016`). Both rows say so.
- Money, imports and approvals — `sys_exchange_rate` `apiEnabled` (`:170-173`) read by `homeAmount` (`field.zod.ts:779`); `sys_import_job` `['get','list']` (`:148-152`) created through `POST /data/:object/import/jobs`; `sys_approval_request` `['get','list']` + `aiReadable` (`:943-957`); `sys_approval_action` `['get','list']`; `sys_approval_delegation` full (`:235-241`).
- Sharing, ownership and routing — `sys_record_share` `['get','list']` (`:326-329`); `sys_share_link` (`:299-305`); `sys_sharing_rule`, `sys_queue`, `sys_queue_member`, `sys_assignment_rule` unrestricted, authored through the stack keys `sharingRules` / `queues` / `assignmentRules` (`stack.zod.ts:1001`, `:1013`, `:1022`).
- Integration and settings — `sys_webhook` full CRUD, stack key `webhooks` (`stack.zod.ts:1061`); `sys_setting` `['get','list']` (`:249-259`); `sys_personal_view` default-open (`:133-137`). Actions may target platform objects (`stack.zod.ts:6071-6082`).

</details>

### Tests

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 scripts/` — the new `platform-catalog.test.ts` plus the existing `skill-map-guards.test.ts` (output in Verification).
- `check:skill-refs` round-trips the catalog (`gen:skill-refs` then `--check`, in sync, 10 files + the catalog); `check:skill-identifier-liveness` picks the catalog's rows up with no wiring change (Leg 1 reads table rows whose first cell is one backticked identifier).
- Evals are fixtures, not executed here (no eval runner in CI); each case was written against the SKILL text it exercises.

### Acceptance notes

Read first, by risk: (1) `packages/spec/scripts/lib/platform-catalog.ts` — the `APP_FACING_OBJECT_GROUPS` rows and `PLANNED_ROWS` (the hand-written prose the page carries); (2) `skills/objectstack-project/SKILL.md` §0 question 3 (`:46-51`) and §5 step 4 (`:179-181`); (3) `scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs`, the one regexp line.

Two-minute check: open `skills/objectstack-project/references/platform-catalog.md`; every object row shows a `sys_*` name, a package, a "what you would otherwise build" cell and a reach cell; the Planned table has two rows, both marked **not available**, each linking to its contract. Then `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec gen:skill-refs && git status --short skills/` prints nothing.

### Verification

- A2 — `packages/spec/src/shared/value-domain.zod.ts:96-100` three members, `:114-118` `VALUE_DOMAIN_FIELD_NAMES`; `platform-object-names.ts:37` `PLATFORM_OBJECTS_BY_PACKAGE`, `:177` `CLOUD_PROVIDED_OBJECT_NAMES`, `:193` `PLATFORM_PROVIDED_OBJECT_NAMES`. - A3 — `skills/objectstack-ai/SKILL.md:209` `list_objects` filters system objects by default, so an MCP build cannot discover the platform objects by listing: the catalog is their only door, which is why question 3 is inside §0 (the MCP-only set).
- A4 — `check:skill-refs` = `tsx scripts/build-skill-references.ts --check` (`packages/spec/package.json:281`); the catalog is emitted through the same `createSink` emit/flush, managed by its own `manageDir` call (objectstack-project is not in `SKILL_MAP`, unchanged); `check:skill-identifier-liveness` walks `skills/**/*.md` including `references/` (its self-test pins that) — Leg 1 counted 545 citations on this tree, the catalog's included.

</details>

**Deviations from the dispatch order:** none in scope. Two items for L2: (a) the ceiling raise above (the order says pay for added skill bytes; the SKILL.md remainder could not be cut from this file without deleting an instruction, so it went the standing path with the arithmetic in the row — accepted by the seat as a deviation beyond amendment 7012111198); (b) branch is `claude/project-thread-1d1bw6` (claim amendment 7011960871). `main` was merged once, before this PR was opened (token rule: pre-PR).

**Fix round 1 (L2 record 7015659227 → head 0626f7e1):** M1 the value-domain paragraph and eval 23 now state what `main` does (write refusal; ISO 4217 picker for the currency code only; plain text input for a time zone or a country; no list or filter reads the domain). M2 the `sys_mailbox` row: engine-owned, read-only for `manage_mailboxes` holders, mounted by `requires: ['mailbox']`, rows only where the host composes an IMAP account source, no Setup entry; the `sys_mail_message` row says where its rows come from. S1 the ceiling row and this body cite 6513306068 alone; the card's own grading is its scope. S2 the hand-written text is priced in the pin test (1583/1583, shrink-only). S3 eval 22 expects Rec 20 codes as values. S4 the `homeAmount` literal is back, paid by four same-file cuts. N1 positions distribute permission sets. N2 question 3 moved after the own-use paragraph (a reorder, +1 byte: 11977 → 11978, still 2990 tokens). N5 two governed-merges self-test cases (the catalog and its near misses; the prose source pinned under the trusted prefix). N6 the ruled keys on both master-data rows.
